annotations.text: Splash safe areas: the app draws its own close/countdown badge top-right and a TAP TO OPEN caption near the bottom. Nothing important sits in the top 210px or bottom 300px.
RM14.90 confirmed — same shelf price as Mont Blanc, which Choc Blanc sells alongside rather than replaces. Base cup costs RM3.45 (Mont Blanc's recipe plus 10g chocolate powder), a 76.9% margin.

Social set carries NO price — deliberate. A price baked into the image dates the post and drags comparison into the comments; put RM14.90 in the caption where it can change without a re-export. Story keeps 250px clear at the top and 330px at the bottom for Instagram's own chrome and the link sticker.
